ruleDefinitions.name: Execute Code with Pester.bat
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects code execution via Pester.bat (Pester - Powershell Modulte for testing)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Pester.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-Help.*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*pester.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*help.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\?.*")))
